notices.text: Mic every main and rod journal in two axes at three points for taper and out-of-round. Check crank runout on V-blocks. Read the old bearing shells like a diagnostic: even grey wear is normal; copper showing through is overload or oil starvation; embedded glitter is the IMS bearing debris that has been circulating. Documented finding worth knowing — rod bearing 6 commonly shows the heaviest thrust-face wear, consistent with being furthest from the oil pump. Check rod big-end bore roundness and rod straightness; have rods resized if outside spec.
